Oral retinoids, such as acitretin, isotretinoin, and alitretinoin, also represent appropriate treatment options.[1][32][1][36]

A new glucosylceramide synthase inhibitor, miglustat, which has been used to treat Gaucher disease and Niemann-Pick disease, has been developed and has been found to increase the adhesion strength of desmosomes in keratinocytes in patients with Darier disease, thus providing promise for a future treatment for this disease.[4][12][37]
